blurb: Our mission is to instill interest in and to preserve and protect Okanogan County’s history, and to act as a coordinating group for the major county museums. The Society is comprised of the Okanogan Museum, Wilson Research Center, and Firehall (see photo above), the Conconully Museum, the Molson Schoolhouse & old townsite, and the Shafer Museum.
